lascaux4.name: Lascaux IV
lascaux4.slogan: Seventeen thousand years of bulls, walked through at arm's length.
lascaux4.line: Marcel Ravidat, 18, found the original cave in September 1940 after his dog slipped into a hole under an uprooted tree.

sarlatoldtown.name: Sarlat Old Town
sarlatoldtown.slogan: Honey-coloured stone lanes, saved from the bulldozers.
sarlatoldtown.line: Sarlat was among the first towns protected under the 1962 Malraux law, which saved its medieval centre from demolition.

rocamadoursanctuary.name: Rocamadour
rocamadoursanctuary.slogan: A whole sanctuary bolted to a cliff, 216 steps up.
rocamadoursanctuary.line: Pilgrims traditionally climbed the Grand Escalier's 216 steps on their knees, and Henry II of England came in 1159.

perigueuxstfront.name: Saint-Front Cathedral
perigueuxstfront.slogan: Five white domes and a Byzantine skyline on the Isle.
perigueuxstfront.line: Built as a Greek cross under five domes, the cathedral was modelled on St Mark's Basilica in Venice.

perigueuxvesunna.name: Vesunna Museum
perigueuxvesunna.slogan: A Roman townhouse under a Jean Nouvel glass roof.
perigueuxvesunna.line: Jean Nouvel's museum opened on 12 July 2003 around a Roman domus found in 1959 while digging housing foundations.
